question: Which of the following keyboard shortcuts is commonly used to rename a file or folder in Windows OS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**F2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **F2** is a keyboard shortcut commonly used in Windows OS to rename a file or folder.

• This shortcut allows you to quickly change the name of the selected file or folder without having to right-click and select the rename option.

• It is a universally recognized shortcut across different versions of the Windows operating system.

• Using the F2 key is efficient and helps improve productivity by reducing the time taken to perform this task.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Ctrl + F5:** This keyboard shortcut is typically used to refresh the content of a web page in most web browsers, bypassing the cache.

• **Alt + Enter:** This shortcut is used in Windows Explorer to open the properties window of the selected file or folder.

• **Ctrl + R:** This is generally used to refresh the active window in some applications, but it is not used for renaming files or folders in Windows.

• **F2:** This is the correct shortcut for renaming a file or folder in Windows OS.
